headlines.description: — Colt Keith homered and the Detroit Tigers ended a seven-series losing streak with a 7-2 win over the Minnesota Twins on Wednesday afternoon.
headlines.shortLinkText: Colt Keith homers as young Tigers lineup beats struggling Twins, 7-2

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Athletics Athletics

headlines.description: — Henry Bolte hit a solo home run in the third inning and Tommy White scored on a wild pitch as the Athletics beat the Toronto Blue Jays 2-0 on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Henry Bolte's homer in the 4th inning helps Athletics beat Blue Jays 2-0

events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Shay Whitcomb's RBI double capped a six-run rally with two out in the eighth inning as the San Francisco Giants beat the St. Louis Cardinals 7-6 on Wednesday to complete a series sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: Whitcomb's double caps Giants' 6-run rally in a 7-6 victory over the Cardinals

headlines.description: — Rookie Kade Anderson picked up his first major league victory with six sharp innings, and Cole Young hit a two-run double as the Seattle Mariners beat the Texas Rangers 3-2 on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rookie Kade Anderson picks up first win with 6 sharp innings as Mariners beat Rangers 3-2

events.name: Washington Nationals at San Diego Padres

headlines.description: — Jackson Merrill homered twice, had a career-high six RBI and fell a double short of a cycle to help the San Diego Padres beat the Washington Nationals 9-2 on Wednesday after the hottest first-pitch temperature in Petco Park history at 95 degrees.
headlines.shortLinkText: Merrill homers twice and drives in 6 runs in the Padres' 9-2 victory over the Nationals

headlines.description: — Dylan Beavers had two hits and three RBI in an eight-run third inning that carried the Baltimore Orioles past the Cleveland Guardians 9-5 Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Beavers gets 2 hits, 3 RBIs in 8-run inning that lifts Orioles past Guardians 9-5

headlines.description: — Kyle Schwarber hit a grand slam for his majors-leading 44th home run, Trea Turner also homered and the Philadelphia Phillies overcame two deficits to beat the Houston Astros 11-7 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Schwarber hits grand slam for 44th homer in Phillies' 11-7 win over Astros

events.name: New York Mets at Miami Marlins

headlines.description: — Francisco Lindor hit a three-run homer, Christopher Morel added a two-run shot and finished a triple shy of the cycle as the New York Mets outslugged the Miami Marlins 15-14 Wednesday night to complete a series sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lindor and Morel power the Mets to a 15-14 win over the Marlins

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Zach Neto hit a three-run homer over the Green Monster, Ryan Johnson gave up three runs over six innings and the Los Angeles Angels beat the Boston Red Sox 6-4 on Wednesday night to take the series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Neto hits 3-run HR over Green Monster as Angels beat Red Sox 6-4 to take series

events.name: Colorado Rockies at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Rookie George Lombard Jr. became the second-youngest player in Yankees’ history to hit a grand slam as New York beat the Colorado Rockies 6-1 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rookie Lombard hits 1st career grand slam as the Yankees beat the Rockies 6-1

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at Atlanta Braves

headlines.description: — Victor Mesa Jr. had two hits, including a home run, Griffin Jax gave up only two hits and one run in five innings and the Tampa Bay Rays beat the Atlanta Braves 7-2 on...
headlines.shortLinkText: Victor Mesa Jr. hits homer in support of Jax as Rays top Braves 7-2 in matchup of first-place teams

events.name: Arizona Diamondbacks at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — Bobby Witt Jr. hit a three-run home run in the fifth inning and the Kansas City Royals beat the Arizona Diamondbacks 5-2 on Wednesday night in a game that was delayed 50 minutes by rain at the outset.
headlines.shortLinkText: Witt homers to help the Royals beat the Diamondbacks 5-2

headlines.description: — Christian Yelich hit a three-run homer, Logan Henderson threw five innings of two-hit ball and the Milwaukee Brewers completed a sweep of rival Chicago, holding on for an 8-6 victory Wednesday night to extend their NL Central lead to 10 games over...
headlines.shortLinkText: Henderson, Yelich lead Brewers past Cubs for series sweep

events.name: Pittsburgh Pirates at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Rookie Esmerlyn Valdez hit a solo shot, rookie Konnor Griffin singled in two runs in Pittsburgh’s three-run seventh inning and the Pirates held on to beat the Chicago White Sox 4-2 on Wednesday night for their third straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Valdez homers and the Pirates use 8 pitchers in a 4-2 win over the White Sox

events.name: Cincinnati Reds at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Yoshinobu Yamamoto struck out 10 while scattering three hits over seven innings, Mookie Betts, Max Muncy and Kiké Hernández each hit two-run homers, and the Los Angeles Dodgers routed the Cincinnati Reds 14-1 on Wednesday night for their season-high...
headlines.shortLinkText: Yamamoto strikes out 10 as the Dodgers rout the Reds 14-1 for 7th straight win
